title: WARRANT run
description: One attempt of an agent at an operation of a Change (03 section 4): `<state>/runs/<id>.json`, committed with the work. The active Run is named by `<state>/runs/current`, which is not committed. Written only by the CLI; it names no frontend.

id.description: Run id `RUN-<ULID>`, equal to the file name without `.json` (ADR-0012).

change.description: Name of the Change the Run works on.

operation.description: Operation of the Run: `specify` edits the artifacts of the Change, `implement` its code and tests, `review` reviews its spec and writes nothing (04 section 3).

task.description: Label of the task the Run is for, as given to `run start --task`; not checked.

model.description: Model the agent of the Run is backed by.

write_scope.description: Globs of the project paths the operation may write; guard denies an edit outside them. Not empty, except for operation `review`, where it is empty.

items.description: One glob, relative to the project root.

scope.description: Globs of `run start --scope` that narrow `write_scope`: a path must match both; empty narrows nothing.

items.description: One glob, relative to the project root.

branch.description: Git branch the Run started on: `HEAD` when detached, empty when git could not say.

finished_at.description: When the Run finished (RFC 3339); absent while it runs.

run_state.description: State axis of a Run (02 section 2).

context_hash.description: Hash of the Context Pack the Run started with: its `items` and `rules`.

effective_policy_hash.description: `hash` of the effective policy of the Change when the Run started (`warrant resolve`).

spec_tree.description: Hash of the spec tree of the Change (`proposal.md`, `specs/**`) at HEAD when a `review` Run started (ADR-0036 section 3): required for operation `review`, absent for the others.

evidence.description: Evidence records produced by the Run.

guard_events.description: Decisions of `warrant guard` during the Run, oldest first.

items.description: One decision of guard on one action of the agent.

action.description: Kind of the action: a file edit, a shell command or anything else.

items.description: One POSIX path relative to the project root.

findings.description: Codes of the findings reported to the agent after the action.

rules_shown.description: Ids of the `rule/1` rules whose text was shown to the agent with this decision.

argv.description: The shell command guard denied by a prefix of `execution.guard_prefixes`, as words.
